title: Oslotrippelen 2026 (marathon + half + 10K)
license: MIT (inherited from the three bundled Oslo component entries)
attribution: Bundled Oslo 2026 marathon, half marathon and 10K; original catalogue attribution fields: No / None.
notes: Combined from the existing 2026 Oslo courses in the organizer's stated order: marathon, half marathon, then 10K (73.2925 km nominal total). Coordinates and elevation are unchanged. Three separate tracks omit untimed transfers and avoid drawing artificial connections. This is a combined challenge, not a separate continuous course. Select CUSTOM DISTANCE and enter 73.2925 km. Compare the component courses with your edition before printing.
